versions.subject: Rule: Renamed PowerShell.exe
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Description: Windows PowerShell
exclusion_1:
    Image:
        - powershell.exe
        - powershell_ise.exe
exclusion_2:
    Description: Windows PowerShell ISE
condition: all of selection and not (1 of exclusion_*)
versions.spl: EventID=1 Description="Windows PowerShell" NOT (Image IN ("powershell.exe", "powershell_ise.exe") OR Description="Windows PowerShell ISE")

versions.subject: Rule: fixed bug in Renamed PowerShell rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Description: Windows PowerShell
exclusion_1:
    Image:
        - '*\powershell.exe'
        - '*\powershell_ise.exe'
exclusion_2:
    Description: Windows PowerShell ISE
condition: all of selection and not (1 of exclusion_*)
versions.spl: EventID=1 Description="Windows PowerShell" NOT (Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe") OR Description="Windows PowerShell ISE")
